decisions.choice: Select the explicit subdivision ending at plī. The broad through-end-of-gaṇa interpretation is retained as an alternative source reading, not silently merged into this profile. Vṛī/bhrī/kṣī and heṭ therefore do not receive shortening here.

evidence.anchor: पू इत्येवमादीनां ह्रस्वो भवति शिति परतः

decisions.choice: Retain both commentary readings for kṣiṇ, ṛṇ, tṛṇ and ghṛṇ. Guṇa is caused by u before inspecting the ending; resulting rṇ clusters block optional affix-u deletion in the guṇa branches.
Defer pṛ/spṛ/smṛ despite absent Vedic tags because the selected commentary describes them as Vedic. Admit kṣi with its raw Vedic tag retained because classical use is explicitly licensed.
Use the explicitly nasal initial u marker in source entry 1090060 and the traditional u-it reading. Preserve the modern note reporting the alternative root-member interpretation.

evidence.anchor: केषाञ्चन पण्डितानां मतेन अस्मिन् धातौ विद्यमानः आदिस्थः उकारः धात्ववयवः ज्ञेयः, न हि इत्संज्ञकः ।

decisions.choice: The selected Siddhāntakaumudī field prints hiṭhṇāti, compatible with its broader shortening discussion. This profile uses the separately explicit narrow pvādi endpoint and retains heṭh; the printed shortened word is not counted as its witness.
Use the explicit penultimate-n deletion of 6.4.24 before śnā. The selected Siddhāntakaumudī śranthāti spelling is retained as a disagreement rather than counted as a witness for śrathnāti.

decisions.choice: Do not admit 1090015 śṝñ in this stage. Its inserted source position and the selected traditional named pvādi sequence do not resolve the shortening membership; the comparison table alone is insufficient. The later parasmaipada śṝ entry 1090021 is independently identified.

boundary: Source interpretations and differing printed forms are retained. Neither the primary files nor earlier evidence packets are edited.
